Ek chhoti si
dil ki baat.

M

Meri Muskan,

Kabhi kabhi dil mein itna pyaar hota hai ki lafz sach mein chhote pad jaate hain... aur aapke liye mere dil mein shayad wahi pyaar hai. Aap meri zindagi mein sirf ek khoobsurat hissa bankar nahi aayi hain, aap dheere-dheere meri har khushi, har sukoon aur meri har chhoti si dua ka hissa ban gayi hain. Aapki ek muskaan mera poora din badal sakti hai, aur aapki aankhon mein zara si udaasi ho toh pata nahi kyun, dil khud-ba-khud bechain ho jaata hai. Aapke saath rehkar mujhe samajh aaya ki mohabbat sirf kisi ko paane ka naam nahi hai... mohabbat toh kisi ki khushi ko apni khushi se zyada mehsoos karna hai. Aap khush hoti hain toh dil sach mein khush hota hai, aur bas yahi chahta hai ki duniya aapko utni hi khushiyan de, jitni khushiyan aapne meri zindagi mein bhar di hain. Main shayad har baar woh sab nahi keh paata jo mere dil mein hota hai, shayad har baar apne pyaar ko sahi lafzon mein samjha bhi nahi paata... lekin ek baat poori sachchai se keh sakta hoon— aapko chaahna meri zindagi ki sabse khoobsurat feeling hai. Aur agar zindagi mujhe baar-baar ek hi sawaal pooche, ki kisko apna banana hai, kiske saath chalna hai, kiske saath har khushi aur har mushkil baantni hai... toh mera jawab har baar wahi rahega— aap. Happy Birthday, my love. ❤️

Meri bas ek dua hai aap hamesha khush rahen, dil se muskuraati rahen, apne saare dreams poore karein... aur zindagi chahe jitne turns le, main har turn mein aapke saath hoon and rahunga. Aap meri partner hain, meri other half ho, meri love ho... aur haan, meri zindagi bhi. 💗💓💝

Aapse bahut, bahut, bahut pyaar hai. Aaj bhi. Kal bhi. Har baar bhi. 🥰
